title: Accepted candidate to validated pending worker

scenes.title: Accepted candidate to validated pending worker
scenes.text: Business Case 10 begins when an accepted application becomes eligible for controlled onboarding handoff. Candidate, application, PreHire and PendingWorker remain linked, correctable and reconciled. The governed record is NHR-DEMO-001. The accountable actors are People Operations, HRIS Operator, Configuration Admin, New Hire. This demonstration uses synthetic browser-memory data and creates no database, provider, message or external-system effect.

scenes.title: 4 accountable processes
scenes.text: The action-level data-flow diagram defines 4 processes before product navigation. Every process identifies the actor, screen, action, input, output, business object, event, governed store, rule, denial and recovery. The highlighted path keeps each business grain and version distinct.

scenes.title: Actor, action, evidence and downstream state
scenes.text: Process 1, People Operations: Confirm identity lineage. The action review source versions produces eligible handoff projection in the Handoff ledger. Process 2, Configuration Admin: Assign approved template. The action test population and pin version produces version-pinned onboarding plan in the Onboarding ledger. Process 3, HRIS Operator: Map and validate worker. The action compare source and destination fields produces staged pendingworker in the HRIS staging ledger. Process 4, New Hire: Activate purpose-limited identity. The action accept invitation and review profile produces active new-hire session in the Identity ledger.

scenes.title: Open PWH-DEMO-001 in context
scenes.text: The actual product route is /hr/onboarding/new-hires/NHR-DEMO-001. It presents prehire and pendingworker mapping and reconciliation in the surrounding recruitment or onboarding workspace. The screen remains a wireframe, but its identifiers, current state, navigation, data relationships and action boundaries match the business contract used by the connected workbench.

scenes.title: Inspect fields, scope and business grains
scenes.text: The seeded workbench follows record PWH-DEMO-001. Its governed fields are PreHire, PRE-DEMO-001 , source offer v4; PendingWorker, PWH-DEMO-001 , staged; Mapping, MAP-HRIS-012 , v8; Business key, PRE-DEMO-001|2026-11-16; Location source, SF-HYBRID; Destination result, SF-CA-HYBRID invalid. Field classifications remain visible so the presenter can distinguish public, internal, confidential and restricted projections for the active persona.

scenes.title: Stage and reconcile worker
scenes.text: With People Operations selected, we perform stage and reconcile worker. The guard requires identity lineage, mapping version, required fields and idempotency pass. The state changes from Staged with 1 error to Reconciled, records PendingWorkerReconciled, writes to the HRIS staging ledger, and creates the handoff: New hire receives purpose-limited invitation.

scenes.title: Simulate location-code rejection
scenes.text: We now exercise the controlled exception: Simulate location-code rejection. The prepared failure is Destination rejects SF-CA-HYBRID location code. Unsupported downstream work stops, successful prior evidence remains intact, and the state-change receipt assigns explicit recovery without hiding the failed attempt.

scenes.title: Correct mapping and replay
scenes.text: The owned recovery is Correct mapping and replay. It reuses the governed business context without duplicating completed effects. The new receipt preserves previous state, current state, actor, event and correlation key. The control center and handoff inbox then expose the same recovery through first-pass validation, retries and reconciliation age and minimum-context next-actor work.

scenes.title: Candidate, application, PreHire and PendingWorker remain linked, correctable and reconciled.
scenes.text: Business Case 10 is complete. We demonstrated the level-two process contract, the actual product route, governed field projections, the primary state transition, a controlled exception, targeted recovery, causal dashboard evidence and the next-actor handoff. Candidate, application, PreHire and PendingWorker remain linked, correctable and reconciled. Production identity, persistence, integrations and external delivery remain separate implementation gates.
